name: Hawn State Park
story: Hawn State Park is a forest located in Missouri, USA. The nearly 5,000 acres include three state-designated natural areas: Pickle Creek, LaMotte Sandstone Barrens, and Botkins Pine Woods. The first 1500 acres were willed to the state in 1952 by Helen Coffer Hawn.
matters: The park includes three state-designated natural areas: Pickle Creek, LaMotte Sandstone Barrens, and Botkins Pine Woods. Orchid Valley is also considered part of the park.
